subject: general
question: The subject 'Marriage' belongs to the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Concurrent List**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Marriage is a subject of the concurrent list in the Indian Constitution: 
 
• List: Concurrent
 
• Subjects: Marriage, divorce, education, forests, trade unions, adoption, succession
 
• The concurrent list includes subjects that are of common interest to both the Union and the States.
 
• Both the Central and state governments can make laws on these subjects.
 
• However, the law made by the state government must be in conformity with the law made by the central government on the same subject. 
 
• The Indian Constitution's 7th Schedule divides powers between the Union and State governments through three lists: Union List, State List, and Concurrent List. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Union List, State List, and Concurrent List are three lists in the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India that divide the powers between the Union and State governments: 
 
• Union List
 
• Subjects of national importance that only the Central Government can legislate on.
 
• Examples include defense, foreign affairs, atomic energy, and currency. 
 
• State List
 
• Subjects of local and state interest that State Governments can legislate on.
 
• Examples include police, public health, agriculture, and local government. 
 
• Concurrent List
 
• Subjects that both Parliament and State Legislatures can legislate on, but central laws take precedence in case of conflict.
 
• Examples include education, marriage and divorce, and bankruptcy and insolvency. 
 
• The Central Government also has residual powers, which are subjects that came into existence after the constitution was written.
 
• Examples of residuary subjects include computer software, information technology, and space technology.
